items.markdown:
A thermal diamond tester is `a portable electronic tool that measures how fast heat moves through a gemstone to verify its authenticity`.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Best-Sellers-Diamond-Tester-Pen/dp/B09TXKBN7Z)[[2]](https://www.naturaldiamonds.com/natural-diamond-types-and-alternatives/diamond-tester/)[[3]](https://www.esplingjewelers.com/blogs/news/are-diamond-testers-accurate)

### How It Works

- **Thermal Conductivity:** Diamonds are exceptional heat conductors. When the heated metal probe touches a real diamond, heat disperses rapidly.[[1]](https://www.naturaldiamonds.com/natural-diamond-types-and-alternatives/diamond-tester/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DAWB9YSOSUe/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.esplingjewelers.com/blogs/news/are-diamond-testers-accurate)
- **Simulant Detection:** Materials like cubic zirconia (CZ) and glass retain heat longer because they are poor thermal conductors.[[1]](https://www.esplingjewelers.com/blogs/news/are-diamond-testers-accurate)
- **The Moissanite Limitation:** Basic thermal testers cannot tell the difference between a diamond and moissanite because moissanite also conducts heat very well, often registering a false positive as a "diamond".[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DAWB9YSOSUe/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.jewelerstoystore.com/category-s/1088.htm)

### Popular Options and Pricing

Add to list A reliable, portable entry-level thermal tester with a thin retractable probe, priced around $129.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15309541248807741791,catalogid:11599343801823466318,gpcid:4021786140391479816,mid:576462609555770041&ibp=oshop)Add to list A dual thermal and electrical conductivity tester featuring an ergonomic design and independent UV light control, priced around $295.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2462290222577300719,catalogid:16904951386229591398,gpcid:3158533465650602444&ibp=oshop)Add to list An advanced device combining both thermal conductivity and reflectivity testing to accurately separate diamonds from moissanite and colored gemstones, priced around $419.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:5535570316724005552,catalogid:16265876548310244220,gpcid:15323892681856842921,mid:576462453087140477&ibp=oshop)Show more

- What **types of stones** you plan to test (just diamonds, or moissanite and colored gems too?)
- Your **budget**
